description: The run in progress, if any: how many answers are done of how many, each model's cells as they settle, and outcome counts; plus the poll's status, when it next runs, and the last run that settled. Poll this every few seconds while a run is active; when last_settled changes, read get_results. (GET /api/v1/polls/{id}/status)

id.description: The poll's id, or its public address (slug).
